pairs.subject: live-chat-moderation-and-anti-bait
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/brain/Viewer.tsx:4 This context is an operator-only console that reads recorded transcripts and ledgers after the fact. It composes no host speech, builds no host prompt, and draws nothing on the broadcast canvas, so the subject's precondition (a generated host reading live chat) does not hold here. A search of apps/console/src/pages/brain for deflect/inject/bait/penalt found nothing. The only moderation code is a counter of input-stage moderation outcomes (brainModel.ts:169) for the picker funnel.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/brain/Viewer.tsx:80 Transcript text is shown only to the operator in the console detail pane. It is not a spoken or broadcast path, so this context has no door for an output gate to sit at. The broadcast stage is a separate surface.

apps/console/src/pages/brain/brainModel.ts:169 The context only counts pre-filter outcomes (dropped/collapsed) that are already recorded. It builds no host prompt, so it cannot decide whether a tag or a payload reaches one.
apps/console/src/pages/brain/Instruments.tsx:90 The funnel shows aggregate counts past moderation. Per-viewer standing and picker down-weighting live in the daemon picker/moderator, not here.
